## Published Research Articles
1. **India International Bullion Exchange (IIBX) & India's Bullion Market Architecture**
   - URL: https://www.rakshitjain.in/research/iibx-and-indias-bullion-market
   - Category: Market Structure & Exchange Mechanics
   - Summary: Technical analysis of the India International Bullion Exchange (IIBX) established in GIFT City IFSC, exploring how Bullion Depository Receipts (BDRs) in dematerialized form replace physical transit risk, the regulatory role of IFSCA, vault custody protocols, and Qualified Jeweller (QJ) onboarding workflows under DGFT and RBI frameworks.
   - Author: Rakshit Jain (PDEU ICT)

2. **20/50 SMA Crossover Backtest & Strategy Analysis**
   - URL: https://www.rakshitjain.in/research/sma-strategy-backtesting
   - Category: Quantitative Research & Algorithmic Trading
   - Summary: Quantitative evaluation of a vectorized 20-day / 50-day Simple Moving Average (SMA) crossover trend-following strategy evaluated on historical NSE equity data (Infosys - INFY and Tata Investment Corp - TATAINVEST). Analyzes Sharpe ratio trade-offs, look-ahead bias elimination by lagging signals by one period, maximum drawdown reduction (reducing INFY max drawdown from -36.4% to -18.2%), and real-world execution frictions including exchange fees and STT.
   - Author: Rakshit Jain (PDEU ICT)

3. **Financial Workflows to FinTech Products: Bridging the Institutional Interface Gap**
   - URL: https://www.rakshitjain.in/research/financial-workflows-and-fintech-products
   - Category: Product Engineering & Financial Architecture
   - Summary: Product architecture essay investigating why institutional capital and compliance departments struggle with fragmented legacy software interfaces, examining Compliance as Code principles, and detailing design lessons from building the LawPrix criteria-based routing platform.
   - Author: Rakshit Jain (PDEU ICT)

   - Role: Financial Markets / Operations Intern (May 2026 – July 2026)

## Key Projects
1. **Market Sentiment Analyzer & Backtesting Engine**
   - Technology: Python, Pandas, NumPy, yFinance, Matplotlib.
   - Scope: Vectorized 20/50 Simple Moving Average (SMA) crossover strategy backtested on historical NSE equities (INFY and TATAINVEST).
   - Results: Shifted execution to avoid look-ahead bias; reduced INFY maximum drawdown from -36.4% (buy-and-hold) to -18.2% and lowered volatility to 15.3% (Sharpe Ratio 0.35).
   - Repository: https://github.com/rakshitjainai/market-sentiment-analyzer

2. **LawPrix**
   - Technology: React.js, Python, REST APIs.
   - Scope: Legal matchmaking platform replacing paid sponsor bidding with criteria-driven routing, Bar Council verification, and milestone progress tracking.
   - Result: 2nd Runner-Up at the national Tutedude Buildathon 2025 hackathon.
   - Live URL: https://lawprix.com/

3. **RegMate**
   - Technology: Python, Streamlit, Pandas.
   - Scope: Structured regulatory compliance tool mapping entity onboarding checklists against IFSCA and DGFT statutory requirements.

4. **Custom Unix Shell in C**
   - Technology: C, Linux, POSIX system calls.
   - Scope: Custom command interpreter supporting process creation (`fork`, `execvp`), input/output redirection (`<`, `>`), and multi-command piping (`|`).
